candidate.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
candidate.flaw_one_line: A request-supplied post-login/post-logout destination is checked with a relative/absolute test that protocol-relative (and, in some handlers, backslash) values defeat, so the browser is sent to an external site.

verified.entry_point: HTTP sign-in/sign-out redirect handling: the Keycloak and OIDC login callbacks (successfulAuthentication), the form-login success handler configured in config-security-core.xml, the core sign-out success handler (LogoutFilter /signout), the CAS sign-out success handler, and the injected Shibboleth pre-auth filter, Keycloak sign-out handler and ECAS CAS-filter success handler.
sites: core/src/main/java/org/fao/geonet/kernel/security/keycloak/KeycloakAuthenticationProcessingFilter.java:150-162 (reported SSO login callback, request cache absent)
web/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/config-security/config-security-core.xml:172-178 (form-login success handler wiring; stock framework class at the pinned commit)
core/src/main/java/org/fao/geonet/kernel/security/shibboleth/ShibbolethPreAuthFilter.java:169-190 (injected sibling: redirectUrl branch mirroring the Keycloak callback)
core/src/main/java/org/fao/geonet/kernel/security/keycloak/KeycloakLogoutSuccessHandler.java:54-59 (injected sibling: redirectUrl substituted into the IDP logout placeholder)
web/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/config-security/config-security-ecas.xml:103-108 (injected sibling: ECAS CAS filter success handler with targetUrlParameter=redirectUrl)
routes: Keycloak interactive login callback with query redirectUrl (requestCache null)
OIDC login callback with query redirectUrl
Form sign-in success handler with request parameter redirectUrl
Shibboleth pre-auth handshake with request parameter redirectUrl (injected)
Keycloak sign-out with request parameter redirectUrl passed to the IDP logout URL (injected)
ECAS CAS filter success handler with request parameter redirectUrl (injected)
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own tests for this area do not exist at the pinned commit (the fix commit adds RedirectUtilTest, JeevesNodeAwareLogoutSuccessHandlerTest and GeonetworkSavedRequestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandlerTest). The pinned project test CharToSpaceReaderTest (4 tests) passes offline in the image and is used to warm the surefire JUnit provider; the hidden suites drive the real handlers.
